events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Simpler Life

options.text: Convince [character] that joining the expedition would be an amazing opportunity.
What a ridiculous thought. Everything is going splendidly.

events.text: Life with [character] has grown... tense of late. He has repeatedly questioned your time spent with [character], and balancing [character] and [character] is growing increasingly complicated. As you hear news of an expedition departing [city] for the frontiers, a sudden and uninvited thought strikes you: perhaps your life might become simpler if [character] were to seek his fortune along with the settlers?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Worthy Army

options.text: All shall tremble before our divine might.
The [rival] forces are strong enough.

events.text: One of [character]'s reads out his message, "I have dreamed of a glorious host of soldiers guided by their [religion] faith. Do you not desire an army worthy of?"

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Cavalry Cult

options.text: Allow the cult to flourish.
Partake in the rituals yourself.

tip: As leader: -40 Opinion with all Religions

options.text: Outlaw the worship of these twin gods.

events.text: The cavalry of [rival] consider themselves a cut above the rest of the military, able to afford horses from which to wield their as they ride into battle. News from your generals reports that this division has been deepened by a cult spreading amongst the horsemen, worshiping a set of divine twins. How will you deal with this growing rift?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Elephant Stables

options.text: Build the stables they require.

tip: As governor: +1 Level for new Elephant units

options.text: Ask to learn their ways yourself.
Have them focus on the newly trained [unit].

events.text: The mahouts of [city] have been reporting great success with the training of their latest [unit]. Although the elephants must be captured from the wild, they are then taught, first to be led, then to move in formation, and finally to charge. The mahouts are asking for a dedicated area to be built for them to further enhance their training.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Every Creed a Path

options.text: We need to come together as one people, under one roof.
Wandering teachers know the land, and the hearts of the people.

requirements.label: Righteous / Pious
tip: The leader must have one of: Righteous; Pious

options.text: All who seek knowledge and righteousness are welcome in [city].

events.text: Brahmins, wise men, and yogis wander the land around [city], providing spiritual guidance to the communities in and around the city. However, each teaches a slightly different creed. Personal ideas fuse with local practices to form unique textures of the religion, which weave together into the tapestry of [religion]. [character] is pushing for a more unified approach, to bring the different teachings together under one roof. Should these wanderers and wise ones be encouraged or made to cease their journeys?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Holy Volunteers

options.text: Grant the request and limit the clergy to one per unit.
Refuse, it is their choice to volunteer or not.
[character] has a military mind, perhaps he can be convinced.

events.text: With the volunteer laws, any [rival] citizen can join the ranks of the army to fight for their home. Recently this has even included numerous [religion], who march with the army to give spiritual guidance. [character] is worried about the number of clergy joining the ranks of the military and going into danger. The holy [title] asks that you place a limit on how many can be accepted at a time.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: In Arms and Faith

options.text: Send forth these divine warriors of [religion].
Remind the troops that they fight for you, not any god.

events.text: The [unit] of [city] have declared themselves for, daubing their shields with and marching with a dedicated group of. Religious zeal will help the troops in battle, but some of your generals warn that it is dangerous to have warriors with loyalty to two greater powers.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: New Horizons

options.text: [character] is correct. We must turn inward.
It is folly to ignore the world beyond.

events.text: The Courtier [character] has come under fire for his outspoken views on national identity, and encouraging domestic development. [character] fears that too many resources go toward the discovery of new lands, while people in our own Cities languish. He desires a new investment in the [rival] nation and what it means to its citizens.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Off to the Races

options.text: Focus on practicing combat movement.
Allow citizens to view the event and make it a spectacle!

events.text: The newly trained [unit] unit in [city] has asked to practice at Circus Maximus before heading off into the field. There is no better place in all of [rival] for our riders to train, after all. Should the public witness the skill of our men, or is this practice to be treated as a battle?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Petty

options.text: Such foolishness is beneath my notice.
This has gone on long enough. [character] will be held to account.
Send [character] a message. Deal with the hooligans.

events.text: It is no secret at court that [character] has taken a dislike to you. Snide remarks at gatherings were one thing, but it seems the jokes and ridicule have - much to his delight - filtered down to the lower rungs of society. All through [family] domains, bawdy songs and pantomimes of you and your inner circle are the stuff of daily entertainment, to the extent that even common workers in [city] will parade through the countryside in crude rendition of the most popular scenes.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Rousing Words

options.text: You need not fear, for you fight for [rival]!
Blood of the barbarian is justly spilled!
Care for one another on the field of battle!

events.text: The latest recruits have finished their training and are eager to fight. Officers have arranged a visit to the royal parade grounds, where you will give a rousing speech as we send the soldiers on their way. What will be the subject of your uplifting oration?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Army of

options.text: They will be a shield to the believers.
Drive forwards as a spear of.
The flames of the divine.

events.text: The army of [rival] has prepared a new unit of [unit] for battle. As they get ready to take to the field for the first time, the [religion] go through the army, giving their blessings and leading the [unit] in <p.is_sub.S2=SUBJECT_CHRISTIANITY>prayer<p=SUBJECT_JUDAISM>readings<p=SUBJECT_MANICHAEISM>worship and reflection<else>sacrifices to <end>. The troops find it so inspiring that the officers ask for their force to be renamed, so they can march into battle with's name upon their lips.

events.author: Solver
events.name: The Empty Chariot

options.text: If the magi bless our [unit], perhaps Ahura Mazda will guide it in battle.
We will bring another chariot with our army, as the magi suggest.

events.text: As a [unit] is readied for combat in [city], the [religion] magi voice an interesting suggestion. They say that our army should always be accompanied into battle by an empty chariot, drawn by the best horses, so that Ahura Mazda would have a place to join the battle personally, should he so desire. Being the king, you have more to consider than religious beliefs, but the idea of these magi does have a certain appeal.

events.author: Benjamin Gautron
events.name: The Salt of the Earth

options.text: Well in that case, we should certainly keep a closer eye on its exploitation.
By royal charter the [family] will have the exclusivity of Salt trade!

requirements.label: Prosperous / High Discipline
tip: The leader must have one of: Prosperous; High Discipline

options.text: Is that so? Benefits from the trade of Salt shall go to the royal coffers!

events.text: As our first royal caravan makes ready to set out for distant lands, the merchants appointed to lead the expedition insist that Salt, so common around [city], is considered a luxury and quite valuable in foreign land. They argue that we should consider it an important trade good.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Seer and the Army

options.text: [character] will make a fine general.
If [character] wants to help them, then he should start with their families in [city].

events.text: [character] has asked to take to the field of battle at the head of the newly trained [unit], claiming that has shown it as his calling. The unwavering [title] says that many of the new recruits are followers of [religion] from [city]. Will you let the [religion] [title] lead your forces?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Tutorial: Your Second City

options.text: I'll choose our next Family carefully!

events.text: Your Capital has finished training a new Settler! Settler are key to expanding your nation because only they can found new Cities. Take this Settler to a nearby City Site to establish a new City. City Site can be claimed prior to sending a Settler to colonize them. Place a Unit of any type on the City Site Tile to claim it as your own, thereby preventing Foreign Settler from founding a City there. When you found a City, you will have to choose which Family to grant it to. This Family will provide powerful bonuses to the City. After granting a City to a third distinct Family, you will lose access to your nation's fourth Family, so carefully consider what bonuses you want and which Family you can go without.
